intent_en: To illustrate the relative physical size of the Moon compared to Earth, emphasizing that the Moon is unusually large for a satellite.
previous_intent: To illustrate the substantial relative size of the Moon compared to Earth, highlighting that it is the largest moon in the solar system in proportion to its host planet.
narration_support: how big is it in relation to Earth? Quite big, actually. Our Moon is the biggest in the solar system in relation to its planet
chart_support: Side-by-side circles comparing the diameters of Earth and the Moon, visually demonstrating the Moon's substantial size relative to Earth.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly questions the relative size of the Moon and asserts it is the largest relative to its planet. The chart supports this by displaying a visual size comparison of the two bodies with diameter labels, showing the Moon is a significant fraction of Earth's size.
